      (function(){
  var EXP_ID = 15;
  var EXP_NAME = &#34;A/A test for mixpanel tracking&#34;;

  function getCookie(name){
    var m=document.cookie.match(new RegExp(&#34;(?:^|; )&#34;+name+&#34;=([^;]*)&#34;));
    return m?decodeURIComponent(m[1]):null;
  }

  function setCookie(k,v){
    document.cookie = k + &#34;=&#34; + encodeURIComponent(v) + &#34;;path=/;max-age=2592000;SameSite=Lax&#34;;
  }

  // ✅ Helper for tracking offer events anywhere (upsell/downsell)
  // Usage later: window.trackOffer(&#34;upsell_viewed&#34;, { offer_id: &#34;...&#34;, price: 99, currency: &#34;USD&#34; })
  function trackOffer(event, props){
    if(!window.mixpanel || !mixpanel.track) return;

    mixpanel.track(event, Object.assign({
      page_path: location.pathname,
      ab_experiment: (mixpanel.get_property &amp;&amp; mixpanel.get_property(&#34;ab_experiment&#34;)) || getCookie(&#34;ab_experiment&#34;),
      ab_variation: (mixpanel.get_property &amp;&amp; mixpanel.get_property(&#34;ab_variation&#34;)) || getCookie(&#34;ab_variation&#34;)
    }, props || {}));
  }
  window.trackOffer = trackOffer;

  function apply(idx){
    if(idx == null) return;

    var variation = (idx === &#34;0&#34;) ? &#34;Control&#34; : (&#34;Variation &#34; + idx);

    setCookie(&#34;ab_experiment&#34;, EXP_NAME);
    setCookie(&#34;ab_variation&#34;, variation);

    if(window.mixpanel){
      // Register once so all future events get these properties automatically
      mixpanel.register_once(
        { ab_experiment: EXP_NAME, ab_variation: variation },
        &#34;ab_experiment&#34;
      );

      // Keep your assignment event as-is

        experiment_name: EXP_NAME,
        variation: variation,
        source: &#34;testa_cookie&#34;,
        page: location.pathname
      });

    <script>
      function getCookie(name) {
  const cookies = document.cookie.split(&#39;; &#39;);
  for (let cookie of cookies) {
    const [key, value] = cookie.split(&#39;=&#39;);
    if (key === name) {
      return decodeURIComponent(value)
    };
  }
  return null;
}


function setCookieFromUrlParam(cookieName) {
  if (getCookie(cookieName) === null) {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const rawValue = urlParams.get(cookieName);
    const decodedValue = decodeURIComponent(rawValue);
    
    if (decodedValue &amp;&amp; /^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-:]{1,50}$/.test(decodedValue)) {
      const expires = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      document.cookie = 
        `${cookieName}=${encodeURIComponent(decodedValue)};path=/;expires=${expires.toUTCString()};domain=.tryholo.ai;SameSite=Strict;Secure`;
    }
  }
}

setCookieFromUrlParam(&#34;im_ref&#34;);
